quest.title: A Muddy Bizarre Adventure
quest.description: Katheryne seems to be having some trouble with a commission that concerns The Chasm...

talks.objective: Go to the Liyue Adventurers' Guild and talk to Katheryne

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hmm... It seems that the situation has been getting worse over the last two days. The exploration team's movements will be limited as a result...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Who can I get to take this commission up...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: #Ah! {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Your timing truly is impeccable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Impeccable, you say?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like we've got trouble on our hands again.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: For reasons unknown, some dark mud-like substance has come pouring out of the caverns and mines of The Chasm lately.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It is a very sudden affair, and the exploration team has yet to come up with any countermeasure, and so investigations there have started and stopped several times. As such, Khedive has asked the Adventurers' Guild to send help...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Dark mud stuff? Isn't that thing from beneath The Chasm...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That's exactly the substance I speak of. I do not know why it has reached the caverns and mines, but either way, the exploration team's progress has been stymied, and even their day-to-day movements have been affected...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: After all, they rely heavily on the mining tunnels for the transportation of goods and materials.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How long has this been going on?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: For some time now. Khedive says that he's found a researcher from Sumeru who can help him out, but that researcher seems to need help themselves...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I must admit that this has been troubling me ever since.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, y'know, Khedive probably pays pretty well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Has no one stepped forward?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: No, I'm afraid, mostly owing to the extreme danger that the dark mud poses. Quite a few people actually came on account of the reward...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But the moment they heard it was The Chasm, they quickly declined.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: To make things trickier, most adventurers are not very familiar with The Chasm's layout.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: So the one who accepts this commission will have to be someone with no fear of danger and who knows The Chasm like the back of their hand...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: And just as I was puzzling over this matter, you two dropped by.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So that's how it is. Things do seem quite serious, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Right. Let's go have a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let's go now, shall we?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ah, about that... Khedive did say that you just have to look for that other researcher from Sumeru.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Or, to quote him verbatim, "If anyone's willing to help, tell them to go to the campsite at The Chasm. That guy will be there prepping, just as usual."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, then we'll be off.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you. The Chasm's safety is in your hands!

choices.text: I suppose we can help Khedive out.

talks.objective: Go to the mining camp to look for the Sumeru researcher

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Hmm, I didn't think that the environment here would be so unique. In that case, the energy system of the Pursina's Spike will...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Ah, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! It has been a while! Why are the two of you here at The Chasm?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Actually, I do recall Khedive saying that you'd helped the exploration team out a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: That said, the situation in The Chasm has been worsening. It's no place for a walk in the park.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, didn't we just meet a short while ago?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I mean, I do always end up asking you for help, but that's no reason to pretend that you don't recognize me...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Ah, forget it. In that case, allow me to introduce myself once again. I am Hosseini, a researcher at the Akademiya. I've been working on a device known as the Energy Amplifier, and I even went to Inazuma to do some reference work there.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: However, I've run out of operating funds for my research, and so I have to return to Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, okay, Paimon thinks she remembers you now...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: ...I'm quite sure that I've never introduced myself as such.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I received a request from a fellow researcher named Khedive. I owe him a favor regarding research funds from way back...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: So I'm here at The Chasm to help him solve this problem.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Well, I hope that explanation's clear enough. In which case, let me ask the question: Why are you two here at The Chasm?

choices.text: Well, we also just so happen to have received a commission from Khedive...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ah, so that's you! And to think I was worried when Khedive mentioned that he was going to get some people to help out.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Since it's you, I guess there's nothing to worry about.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I must admit that if I were to attempt to resolve the dark mud issue here at The Chasm myself, it would take a lot of time and energy. But with your help, our odds are... well, higher.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you need us to do?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: You've heard of the Pursina's Spike, right? A device that can release energy that disrupts the Ley Lines.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: According to my hypothesis, we can place the Spike at points where the dark mud is pouring out to disrupt the Ley Line movements and clear it away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is the dark mud even related to the Ley Lines?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, they did appear based on anomalies in the Ley Lines, so it is very likely that they are related. That's what Khedive and I have discussed, anyway.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: So, we can use the Spike to disrupt or even close the openings that allow the Ley Lines here to access external elements, which will stop the dark mud.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: However, we were previously just using the Spikes to "disrupt" the Ley Lines. This is the first time I'm using the Spikes to "seal" them.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I have done some estimations and adjusted some of the Spike's parameters. In theory, nothing should go wrong.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: But theory is, as you know, ultimately theory, and theories must all be tested. I was just thinking of beginning the initialization process, in fact, but it has some risks...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, allow me, then...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Hmm, alright, I'll leave it to you.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I will observe from the sides.
